export declare const cutHead: (text: string, max: number) => string;

export declare const cutTail: (text: string, max: number) => string;

export declare function cutWithEllipsis(text: string, limit: number, { unit, prefixLength, trimEnd }?: EllipsisCutOptions): string;

export declare const exceedsCharacters: (text: string, limit: number) => boolean;

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:
